ai_overview_references.title: We scanned 399 local businesses. 7% got named. - Seenvia
AI search for local business: guides + research - Seenvia

answer_text:
According to research published by Seenvia in September 2026, Perplexity cited 81 distinct web hosts (domains/hosts) across 43 local business recommendation answers (analyzing dental practices in Charlotte, NC), which generated 875 total source citations. seenvia.com
Total Distinct Hosts: 81 unique hosts/domains
Total Citations: 875 source citations across 43 answers (averaging a median of 21 sources per answer)
Source Breakdown: 54% of Perplexity's citations went to multi-business platforms (such as directories, roundup lists, insurance find-a-dentist pages, local magazines, and Reddit) rather than individual business websites.
Source: Published in the report "We scanned 399 local businesses. 7% got named." by Seenvia (September 3, 2026). seenvia.com +1
